question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"talk."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Talk" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, **"talk"** is a verb that means to communicate with someone by speaking. (बातचीत करना; जानकारी देने का भाव, विचार आदि व्‍यक्त करने के लिए बोलना, कहना या भाषण देना)
 
 
• **Example**: *"We need to **talk**__ about our project deadline."*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

Correct passage:

I was surprised __first__ at the news that my father spared me any thought, and second at my brother's compliment, __though__ it was backhanded. Dhri __never__ commented on my looks; nor did he encourage me to comment on his. Such useless __**talk**__, he believed, made people vain. Was this another ______ (5) ______ of change? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Ode"** is a noun that means a poem in praise of something or someone. Iविशेष अवसर के लिए या विशेष व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को लक्ष्‍य कर लिखी गई कविता, संबोधन कविता)
 
• **"Disclosure"** is a noun that means the act of making something known or revealing information. (प्रकटीकरण; प्रकट की गई बात)
 
• **"Babble"** is a verb that means to talk in a way that is difficult to understand or in a meaningless way. (एक ही समय में सुनाई पड़ने वाली अलग-अलग बातों की आवाज़; अस्‍पष्‍ट बकबक)
